note: Both sets capture the core rotor speed, pitch, and tip-speed facts correctly and with supporting quotes, and both repeat several facts under both 'rotor' and 'IEA Wind 15-MW reference wind turbine' entities. Set B additionally extracts the DTU Basic Controller pole parameters (0.05 Hz / 70% critical for the partial-load torque controller and 0.03 Hz / 70% critical for the full-load pitch controller) and the PI controller for blade pitch angles, all correctly bound and quoted. Set A omits these controller tuning facts entirely, so B covers the page more completely without introducing errors.
remarks: Both sets state the same facts twice under 'rotor' and 'IEA Wind 15-MW reference wind turbine' (min speed, rated speed, pitch start, 0-degree pitch, positive pitch, tip speed) — a consistent duplication pattern across both extractions. The condition 'at rated rotational speed' on the 95 m/s tip-speed claim is a mild extrapolation of 'resulting in a maximum nominal tip speed of 95 m/s' but is defensible. Neither set extracts the 3 m/s ≤ U ≤ 6.98 m/s minimum-rotor-speed region range, which both leave out.
